parsed.why: Constitutional and statutory gender-identity protections plus working recognition law, though enforcement weak; 2024 survey shows LGBTI exclusion, but no trans-specific police targeting, facility or border restriction documented. Majority poll support for trans rights.

No criminalisation of trans identity, but zero anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, no document recognition, hostile majority (73% dislike gay neighbour), and an ambiguous morality statute used as police bribe lever. Trans risk inferred, not measured.

Universal federal sex-at-birth document/entry regime, passport confiscations, allied advisories, facility bans across many states, custody harm — with no fully working remedy; partly offset by state protections, no criminalisation, courts enjoining some orders.

Documented police sweeps detaining trans women for ID checks, 313 violations (2.5x prior year), birth-sex custody placement with a prison death, prosecution asymmetry, no protections, hostile official rhetoric. State-tolerated targeting dominates.

Gender identity protected since 2013 with damages actually awarded; 2025 hate-crime law covering gender identity; no criminalisation. Gaps remain: uneven state coverage, youth-care restrictions, custody sourced for one state only.
